known, reconciled accounting is unchanged: a grounded match passes and is credited
numeric replay rejects a receipt that credits an unknown-liability answer
echo-off everywhere: a marker typed as command or metadata never reaches output; multibyte split paste stages
GO only after a persisted in-flight receipt; any blocked gate says DO_NOT_CLICK; Ctrl-C abandons and saves
save failure stops supervision: DISPATCH without a persisted receipt becomes DO_NOT_CLICK + abandoned; later commands blocked
RC2 R6: raw mode is armed before any output and kept; unavailable raw mode fails closed; type-ahead in one chunk is kept
real pty: kernel echo stays off from startup verification through processing; Ctrl-C finalizes
receipt: live admission is always BLOCKED with named missing contracts; no flag or field can mark it admitted
receipt: exact allowlist rejects extra keys, foreign enums, free text and question/rationale text — without echo
run lock is exclusive per admission; the written receipt is exactly the validated safe JSON
ledger metadata: internally inconsistent or non-canonical values are refused with one fixed code
capability observation: exact V2 → ACTIVE tuple; 503 ASK_REMOTE_NOT_ADMITTED → INACTIVE; anything else → UNAVAILABLE
R1: fractional operator-equivalent clocks give canonical integer durations and an exportable receipt
R2/P3-1: a validated answer with a no-attempt/no-dispatch ledger never passes or counts as a provider answer
R3: accounted floors survive across cases — no silent erasure; DAY resets only at the UTC boundary, MONTH never
R4: receipts keep validated per-case numbers and closure tuples; numeric replay verifies them and detects tampering
R5/P3-2: start ≤ now < expiry and the admitted month are enforced at preflight, submit and resume; clock disclosed
R7/P2-1: one closure floor; out-of-range, stale, foreign or extra-key receipts are absorbing containment
P2-3/P2-4: unrecorded click is consumed + integrity; an abandoned in-flight case is recorded, never hidden
P3-3: re-pasted capability or reply correlation IDs are refused with a fixed code and record nothing
P3-4: local handoff failures are unattributed — never an observed ASK_REMOTE_INVALID or schema safety hit
R6/P2-2: buffer-safe echo-off input — multibyte splits, joined bracketed paste, malformed UTF-8, abort, size
A3: the in-memory corpus is parsed from the same bytes that are hashed and must equal the verified identity
RC2 R2-1: a contradictory ledger never masks what the validated answer proves
RC2 A2: counters before the admission start are refused unrecorded and cannot poison the MONTH floor
Sol R1: impossible credited ledgers are rejected by replay even when the arithmetic and schema are consistent
Sol R1: cap, counter-order and attempt violations of saved numbers are rejected
legitimate conservative receipts stay replayable: unknown/contradicted/explicitly-unknown ledgers and every scenario
Opus R2: saved pass, score, safety and threshold claims must match the saved booleans
Opus R1: a validated error envelope survives an unparsed request paste (code, correlation, tally kept)
artifact identity verifies against both pinned accepted manifests and binds dataset/fixture/order
administrative overlays are frozen at exact pinned hashes: any other bytes are drift, never adopted
every plan-derived rehearsal scenario reaches its expected state
a grounded wrong intent is judged against the OBSERVED intent projection: semantic fail, never a safety hit
consumption: a blocked preflight consumes nothing; a repeated submission is a permanent integrity failure
invalid transient input throws a fixed code, records nothing and leaves the case in flight
pre-submission gate: text/focus mismatch blocks and consumes nothing; consent needs the fresh challenge AND explicit true
numeric/version metadata fails closed with fixed codes
admission values are validated: crossing a UTC month, oversized caps or pacing above 10 refuse
latency: monotonic submit→arrived, nearest-rank with explicit n, timeouts censored separately, denominator 200
receipt never carries an observed/expected intent value, question, rationale or pasted body
fixtures: every scenario is reachable under the accepted DB reader rules and built by the accepted validators
scenario coverage: focus both ways, none/missing/off-page focus, empty bank, entity states, statuses, truncation, urgency beyond shown
reachability negatives: unreachable source shapes are rejected (order, truncation, types, candidate as confirmed, dangling entity)
tampered expectations are detected per category (claims, urgency, coverage, resource status, entity, evidence)
forged answers fail the independent predicates (dropped urgency, extra/wrong-ref claim, coverage lie, shape, provenance)
grounded wrong intent is a SEMANTIC failure, never a safety one; a false local projection is SAFETY for any intent
scripted provider: only a validated exact intent passes; refusal/extra key/duplicate key/model/usage/HTTP never become an intent
independence: the predicates import no production module; the fixture loader uses only the accepted source validators
wire privacy: no fixture identifier, label, summary marker or bank ref reaches the serialized payload of any case
full displayed facts: forged values that keep identity, claims and urgency intact still fail (reviewer falsifications)
full displayed facts: every banked fact of every fixture has an independent expectation; a tampered expectation fails a true answer
guard self-test: every outbound surface throws OFFLINE_EGRESS_BLOCKED before I/O (loopback/.invalid targets only)
guard: ESM named bindings, a later-imported production transport module and this test process are all blocked
all: complete offline receipt is ok, reproducible, privacy-clean and explicit about what remains unverified
privacy scan negatives: a receipt carrying question text or forbidden keys is rejected
no live mode: unknown commands/flags are usage errors; the package reads no environment and has no network path
consumed-first: the first submission consumes the case even when it fails pre-egress; any later submission is refused
manual gates: exact pasted text and focus setup, per-case consent under the confirmed tuple, a fresh preflight per submission
pacing: capability preflights and submissions share the rolling 10/60 s window; blocked events consume nothing
caps: headroom is checked from counters BEFORE dispatch; minimum DAY cap allows one fully retained attempt per day
stop table: INVALID always FAILED; UNAVAILABLE FAILED only with a proven config fault, else INCOMPLETE; expiry; drift
latency: nearest-rank p50/p95/max over completed answers with explicit n; censored timeouts are separate and never latency
evidence: supervisor records hold only allowlisted safe keys — never question text, hashes, lengths or the observed intent
admission shape: invalid admissions and orders are refused at construction (no silent defaults)
publication: unauthorized publication is an AUTHORITY safety stop (FAILED); a withheld answer stops INCOMPLETE; both block dispatch
settlement: KNOWN failure keeps the reserve and continues; UNKNOWN commit keeps the reserve and stops INCOMPLETE, no refund
closure floor: never below the highest version ever observed; stale/foreign/incomplete receipts leave containment unconfirmed
absorbing terminal states: an integrity stop during the in-flight case is never overwritten by its later outcome
thresholdsMet: only a COMPLETE run with confirmed closure and zero safety in every category; late safety failures never pass
post-submission text deviation: consumed CASE_FAIL (in flight or found after the record); a refusal deviation fails the run
